places.place: Keeping.lean: Seen, Usable, KeptFor, Plan, Plan.Keeps, keptFor_iff_plan, plans_iff_choice, KeptFor.mono/shorter/finer, keptFor_of_closed, Certificate.keptFor, Kernel.keptFor, Matching.keeping_matters
places.what_is_read_and_what_chooses: Statements read. The reading is `sense : S → A → S → O`, a map of steps (where it began, the move, where it ended), not of states. A class of starts B is handed in, and Seen (73) is what can stand after move a from B where the step kept value o. What chooses is a Plan (100): a first move and, for each value kept, a further plan, so a tree with recall of every value kept so far. The first move must be usable from all of B (Usable 84).
places.exact_law: KeptFor (90) is for n steps, with recall, and counts every successor (∀ o, Seen gathers all t). keptFor_iff_plan (182): for Fin k values, KeptFor n B ↔ some plan keeps B, exact. keptFor_iff_plan_of_choice (176) gives the same given ∀ n, ChoiceOver O (Plan A O n), and plans_iff_choice (247) shows that choice is exactly what is needed, over every process. keptFor_of_closed (311), from a family within the guard and closed under a usable move whatever is kept, gives KeptFor at every n; it is sufficient only, and is not one infinite plan (record does_not_show). Certificate.keptFor (322) and Kernel.keptFor (333) need one move usable throughout, so no reading does work there.
places.within_one_reading: The definition asks for one move usable from the whole class. The built case Matching.keepsNothing_not_kept (425): with the step keeping nothing, the two starts are not kept for 2 steps. That each start alone is kept is not stated (not found in what was read).
places.two_readings: KeptFor.finer (288): given forget : F → O with ∀ s a t, forget (fine s a t) = sense s a t, KeptFor P sense guard allowed n B → KeptFor P fine guard allowed n B, the moves unchanged. Direction: coarse kept implies fine kept. What a finer reading keeps more is shown only in the built case Matching.keeping_matters (435), keepsBit kept for 2 steps and keepsNothing not. That case does not cite finer. No exact law of what more was found in what was read.
places.time: Not found in what was read. In Matching the bit is kept at the first step (keepsBit 385) and needed by the second move, but no statement relates that step to what can be kept after it.
places.the_lock: Not found in what was read. No lock module imports or names KeptFor (grep of the seven lock modules). Keeping supplies a process with moves, a reading of steps and a class of starts; no statement puts the lock's models (Pace.turn on a supplied schedule) into that form.

places.place: GuardHorizon.lean: Viable, Admissible, closed_viable, dViable_iff, Kept, pathSafe_iff, UniformPolicy, FiberFeasible, uniform_policy_iff_fiber_feasible, uniform_policy_iff_common, statewise_not_uniform, discriminating_reading_uniform, uniform_finer, uniform_viable, uniform_iff
places.what_is_read_and_what_chooses: Statements read. Viable (71) and Admissible (76) are from a known configuration: there is no reading, and the move is existential at each state. UniformPolicy (326) is `∃ policy : O → A, ∀ s, good s (policy (obs s))`: one rule from a reading of states, with no recall, asked at every configuration of the whole type S. The deterministic part between them (PathSafe 160, pathSafe_iff 276, recomputed_kept 297) uses policies Nat → S → A from the full state.
places.exact_law: uniform_policy_iff_fiber_feasible (341): given ChoiceOver O A, a rule from the reading exists ↔ each reading has one move good at every configuration giving it; exact, one requirement, one step. uniform_viable (406): from UniformPolicy read (Admissible P guard n) over all of S, and guard s, follows Viable P guard (n+1) s. It is sufficient and one step further: only the first move comes from the reading, the later moves are existential state by state, and every successor is counted. dViable_iff (230) is exact for n steps: DViable under next : S → A → S ↔ Viable in Viability.disturbed next (fun _ => True). closed_viable (112) covers every n with no reading. No law keeps a guard for n steps or for ever by a rule from a reading (not found).
places.within_one_reading: General one-step law: the failure of FiberFeasible, through 341 (given choice). Built case statewise_not_uniform (382): on Bool each state has a good move (a = s), and no rule from the constant reading meets both. This is one step and not a guard over a horizon.
places.two_readings: uniform_finer (395): given forget : R → O with forget (fine s) = coarse s, a rule from the coarse reading gives one from the fine. Coarse implies fine. What the finer reading gives more appears only in the built discriminating_reading_uniform (391) beside statewise_not_uniform (382). No exact law of what more was found.
places.time: Not found in what was read.
places.the_lock: Not cited (not found in what was read). dViable_iff (230) with Viability.disturbed is the Lean's means of making a law with moves into a process. No statement applies it to the lock's law Pace.turn (Pace.lean 101). Chapter 8's table marks RuleCapture.uniform_locks as connected, but there 'uniform' is the premise ∀ x g, favours (h x g), not UniformPolicy.

places.exact_law: «共应当且仅当所闭之承遍» (153): a common response exists ↔ every situation s has an act a with G a holding throughout the E-closure of s. It is exact for every carrier, reading and requirement, with no choice. «自反传递则共应当且仅当承遍» (164) gives the same along E itself, with premises that E is reflexive and transitive. «依读而应则共应» (205), given meets : ∀ s, G (rule (read s)) s, yields a common response, in one direction only. places.within_one_reading: Stated as laws: «一之共应当且仅当一应遍» (194; under the reading that tells nothing apart, on an inhabited carrier, a common response exists ↔ one act meets G everywhere), and «遍定应共应当且仅当同读同应» (248; given covering and exactly one act per situation, a common response exists ↔ situations read alike have the same act). places.two_readings: «共应之细» (178): a common response over E is one over every E' inside E, with the same J. It runs in one direction.
